_description: Map ElevenLabs voice_id → local VoxCPM config. Lets one server handle both Pulse Gaming (Liam) and Sleepy Stories (Christopher) without restart. Path is relative to tts_server/. If voice_id hits the server and is missing here, the server falls back to REF_VOICE_PATH env var (default voice mode).

TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ.ref_voice_text: Welcome, weary traveller. Settle in. Let the world outside fall quiet. Tonight, we walk together through a land that has slept for a thousand years, where kings were buried beneath mountains, and dragons whispered in tongues older than memory. Picture yourself at the edge of a great pine forest at dusk. The sky is the colour of old copper. Snow falls, soft as breath, onto your shoulders, and the air smells of woodsmoke and iron. You are not alone here. The land remembers every footstep it has ever known, and tonight, it remembers yours. Close your eyes. Let your shoulders drop. There is nothing to do. Nothing to fix. Only the story, and the fire, and the slow turning of the world.
